elementary_input: fields, all spatial coordinates, time, field powers 2 and 3, and LLM seed roots of order 0 and at most 6 operations
elementary_functions: All 17 functions in the frozen standard.json
binary_input: fields, all spatial coordinates, time, field powers 2 and 3, and every first directional derivative of every field
binary_policy: Add/Multiply unordered pairs; Subtract/Divide ordered distinct pairs; no parameter-only roots
compatibility: Run the original task-independent 1D or 2D finite constructor on the declared fields and translate outputs into the new grammar
pde_macros: Laplacian and biharmonic of fields; gradient inner products for every field pair; Hessian determinant in 2D; every direction pair D_i(h D_j(g)) and h D_j(g) for declared fields g and coefficients h from fields, spatial coordinates, time, 1, and f/(a+f)
derivative_closure: One frozen snapshot of candidate roots after the above stages; apply every nonzero spatial multi-index with |alpha|+order(E)<=4. New derivatives are not fed back into another full algebra/function pass
graph_nodes: Unique canonical syntax expressions containing a field or coordinate, plus unit constant 1; all nonconstant subexpressions materialized, parameters and other constants stored as attributes
edges: Unique nonconstant immediate operand -> expression dependencies; repeated operands retain their positions on the edge; alternate top-level construction events recorded separately
numeric_validation: Not performed; record domain conditions and pending numeric validity. No fitting, residual ranking, truth scoring or PDE search
